description: Defines the RequestParams class for handling and validating request parameters in the OrangeHRM API v2, including support for various data types, attachments, and date/time parsing.

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: Handles extraction and validation of request parameters, including support for different data types, attachments, and date/time parsing.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter from the specified parameter bag type.

methods.name: getStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter or null, with optional conversion of empty strings to null.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter, throws exception if parameter is an empty string.

methods.name: getIntOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter or null.

methods.name: getFloatOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a float parameter or null.

methods.name: getBooleanOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter or null.

methods.name: getArrayOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an array parameter or null.

methods.name: getAttachmentOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a Base64Attachment object or null, sanitizes SVG content if applicable.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime object, applying timezone if provided.

methods.name: getDateTimeOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the specified parameter bag.

methods.name: isEmptyString
methods.description: Utility method to check if a parameter is an empty string.
